name: Webform Browser Info
description: A hidden Webform element that captures the submitter's browser/device information.
project_description:
The Webform Browserinfo module is an extension of the Webform module providing a hidden Webform field that gathers information about the user's browser, operating system and window configuration to send along with the rest of the form. This can be helpful in e.g. feedback forms or error reports, when this information could prove vital in resolving the issue that a user may experience.

 Back to top 

 
Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Webform

Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 
Configuration 
 After enabling the module, the Webform Browserinfo field can be used and configured like any other Webform field.
